data.description:
Surfaced September 19, 2026 at 13:44 PDT in the health-data evidence brief. Activity dates: May 13 and June 16, 2026; event times below are UTC.

Three preserved Linuxiarz replies titled Re: IowaDataTestDirect, displayed author Analyst, have identical bodies linking five male thyroid-cancer CSVs from Iowa HHS. They are copies of one link collection, not three independent creation events. Their publication times are unknown; September 4 Wayback captures are not publication dates.

Five URLQuery reports contain six requests matching three complete CSV URLs, including unusual x=sht... parameters. Report 26d3ad05 records a May 13 22:36:35.485 request and 22:36:37.077 retry for ages 15–24. Reports 5f8b4c8e, c653b455 and 1c569578 record June 16 requests at 09:43:01.191, 09:52:00.172 and 09:52:03.127 for ages 45–64. Report 487da987 records an 11:35:33.297 request for ages 85+. Five requests have HTTP 200 metadata; the first May attempt has no recorded response before its retry. No exact matches for ages 25–44 or 65–84 were found in this five-report set.

Separate dated Linuxiarz messages on June 16 discuss male thyroid-cancer answers, deadlines, upcoming questions and whether tools remain available. They occur 8h29m–10h21m after the June requests and do not date the Analyst replies or identify the scan submitters.
data.summary: Five URLQuery reports contain six requests matching three complete Iowa thyroid-cancer CSV URLs in preserved Linuxiarz replies.
